title: Canonical Game (v1)
description: Unified schema for game.json, used at both library/games/pc/{steam,<store>}/<id>/game.json and library/games/retro/<system>/<slug>/game.json. Shared fields live at the top level; platform-specific identity lives under "pc" or "retro" per platform_class. Playnite UUIDs are never embedded here — they live only in adapter-only mapping files (see playnite-mapping.schema.json).

id.description: Canonical id. Must equal the enclosing directory slug (steam appid, storefront id, or retro slug).

assets.description: Canonical asset references for this game, by role. Presentation adapters select from these; selection never mutates or promotes asset bytes.

PcIdentity.description: PC identity. Steam is identified by numeric AppID; every other storefront is identified by an opaque storefront_id (its own stable id format).

storefront_id.description: Opaque storefront-native identifier. Required when store != "steam".

RetroIdentity.description: Retro identity is logical (system + slug), decoupled from any single file. Exact-byte releases are tracked separately in library/releases/retro/<system>/<sha256>/ and referenced here by digest and/or filename alias.

releases.description: Known release digests for this logical game (e.g. region/revision variants). Full raw SHA-256, not a truncated or per-block hash.

filename_aliases.description: Historically observed filenames for releases of this game, kept for operator recognition only — never used as identity.
